CHL5222 Final Project

Breastfeeding and HIV Exposure on Infant Growth

2026-03-25

Background

Main outcome: Weight-for-length z-score (zwfl)

HIV-exposed uninfected (CHEU) infants are children born to mothers living with HIV who did not acquire the virus themselves, while HIV-unexposed (CHU) infants are born to HIV-negative mothers. We compare growth trajectories between these groups and assess whether breastfeeding modifies the relationship.

Research objective: To compare the growth trajectory of CHEU and CHU infants over 0–24 months, and to assess whether breastfeeding modifies this relationship.

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(splines)
library(emmeans)
library(ggeffects)
library(broom.mixed)
library(patchwork)
library(janitor)
library(naniar)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

Data Import

dat <- read.csv("hiv.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()

Variable Descriptions

The dataset contains repeated growth measurements of infants followed from birth to 24 months.

Variable Description
newid Unique infant identifier
visit Study visit
infage_month Infant age (months) – time dimension
zwfl Weight-for-length Z-score (primary outcome)
enrol_hiv_status_cat Maternal HIV status – defines CHEU vs CHU
ebf_updated Exclusive breastfeeding status
bf_current_1year Breastfeeding status at 1 year
b1_sex Infant sex
gestage_final Gestational age at birth (weeks)
momage_cat Maternal age category
educ_cat_n Maternal education level

Recode Variables

analysis_dat <- dat |>
  mutate(
    newid = factor(newid),

    # HIV exposure group:
    # "Positive" maternal status = infant HIV-exposed uninfected (CHEU)
    # "Negative" maternal status = HIV-unexposed (CHU)
    hiv_group = case_when(
      enrol_hiv_status_cat == "Positive" ~ "CHEU",
      enrol_hiv_status_cat == "Negative" ~ "CHU",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    hiv_group = factor(hiv_group, levels = c("CHU", "CHEU")),

    # Order visits chronologically for plotting
    visit = factor(visit, levels = c(
      "delivery",
      "week-3",
      "week-6",
      "month-3",
      "month-6",
      "month-9",
      "month-12",
      "month-18",
      "month-24"
    )),

    # Infant sex
    sex = factor(b1_sex),

    # Maternal characteristics
    momage_cat = factor(momage_cat),
    educ_cat_n = factor(educ_cat_n),

    # Breastfeeding -- exclusive (ebf_updated)
    ebf_updated = case_when(
      tolower(ebf_updated) %in% c("yes", "y") ~ "Yes",
      tolower(ebf_updated) %in% c("no", "n")  ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ebf_updated = factor(ebf_updated, levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    # Breastfeeding -- current at 1 year (bf_current_1year)
    bf_current_1year = case_when(
      tolower(bf_current_1year) %in% c("yes", "y") ~ "Yes",
      tolower(bf_current_1year) %in% c("no", "n")  ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    bf_current_1year = factor(bf_current_1year, levels = c("No", "Yes")),

    # Continuous variables
    infage_month  = as.numeric(infage_month),
    gestage_final = as.numeric(gestage_final),
    zwfl          = as.numeric(zwfl),

    # Mean-centred age: improves optimizer convergence and makes the intercept
    # interpretable as expected outcome at the mean observed age (~13 months).
    # Centred age: t* = t - mean(t)
    infage_month_c = infage_month - mean(infage_month, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

Descriptive Statistics

Table 1 – Infant and Maternal Characteristics at Baseline

Baseline is defined as the earliest observation per infant (delivery visit). Continuous variables: mean (SD); categorical: n (%). Significance codes: *p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001.

# ── packages ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# ── helper functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt_n_pct <- function(x, level) {
  n   <- sum(x == level, na.rm = TRUE)
  tot <- sum(!is.na(x))
  pct <- if (tot > 0) round(100 * n / tot, 1) else NA_real_
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)
}

fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  stars <- dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ ""
  )
  if (p < 0.001) return(paste0("<0.001", stars))
  paste0(formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "f"), stars)
}

# ── one row per infant, baseline visit only ───────────────────────────────────
baseline_dat <- analysis_dat |>
  group_by(newid) |>
  slice_min(infage_month, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

chu   <- baseline_dat |> filter(hiv_group == "CHU")
cheu  <- baseline_dat |> filter(hiv_group == "CHEU")
n_chu  <- nrow(chu)
n_cheu <- nrow(cheu)

# ── build table body ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tbl1 <- tribble(
  ~Characteristic,                              ~CHU,                                      ~CHEU,
  # Infant sex
  "Infant sex, n (\\%)",                         "",                                        "",
  "\\hspace{1em}Female",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$b1_sex,  "female"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$b1_sex, "female"),
  "\\hspace{1em}Male",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$b1_sex,  "male"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$b1_sex, "male"),
  # Gestational age
  "Gestational age (weeks), mean (SD)",
    fmt_mean_sd(chu$gestage_final),
    fmt_mean_sd(cheu$gestage_final),
  # Maternal age
  "Maternal age category, n (\\%)",              "",                                        "",
  "\\hspace{1em}25 years and under",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$momage_cat,  "25 and less"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$momage_cat, "25 and less"),
  "\\hspace{1em}26--35 years",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$momage_cat,  "26 to 35"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$momage_cat, "26 to 35"),
  "\\hspace{1em}Over 35 years",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$momage_cat,  "35 and more"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$momage_cat, "35 and more"),
  # Education
  "Maternal education, n (\\%)",                 "",                                        "",
  "\\hspace{1em}Primary or below",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$educ_cat_n,  "Primary or below"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$educ_cat_n, "Primary or below"),
  "\\hspace{1em}Secondary and above",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$educ_cat_n,  "Secondary and above"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$educ_cat_n, "Secondary and above"),
  # Breastfeeding
  "Exclusively breastfed --- Yes, n (\\%)",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$ebf_updated[!is.na(chu$ebf_updated)],   "Yes"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$ebf_updated[!is.na(cheu$ebf_updated)], "Yes"),
  "Breastfeeding at 1 year --- Yes, n (\\%)",
    fmt_n_pct(chu$bf_current_1year[!is.na(chu$bf_current_1year)],   "Yes"),
    fmt_n_pct(cheu$bf_current_1year[!is.na(cheu$bf_current_1year)], "Yes")
)

# ── p-values ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_sex    <- chisq.test(table(baseline_dat$b1_sex,     baseline_dat$hiv_group))$p.value
p_gest   <- t.test(gestage_final ~ hiv_group,         data = baseline_dat)$p.value
p_momage <- chisq.test(table(baseline_dat$momage_cat, baseline_dat$hiv_group))$p.value
p_educ   <- chisq.test(table(baseline_dat$educ_cat_n, baseline_dat$hiv_group))$p.value

p_ebf <- chisq.test(table(
  baseline_dat$ebf_updated[!is.na(baseline_dat$ebf_updated)],
  baseline_dat$hiv_group[  !is.na(baseline_dat$ebf_updated)]
))$p.value

p_bf1yr <- chisq.test(table(
  baseline_dat$bf_current_1year[!is.na(baseline_dat$bf_current_1year)],
  baseline_dat$hiv_group[       !is.na(baseline_dat$bf_current_1year)]
))$p.value

# p-value column: header rows get the value, sub-rows get ""
tbl1$`p-value` <- c(
  fmt_p(p_sex),    "", "",          # sex header + Female + Male
  fmt_p(p_gest),                    # gestational age
  fmt_p(p_momage), "", "", "",      # maternal age header + 3 levels
  fmt_p(p_educ),   "", "",          # education header + 2 levels
  fmt_p(p_ebf),                     # exclusive BF
  fmt_p(p_bf1yr)                    # BF at 1 year
)

# ── render to LaTeX ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Row indices of bold category-header rows (1-indexed, header row = 0)
bold_rows <- c(1, 5, 9, 12)   # sex, maternal age, education, (gest-age is a single row)

latex_tbl <- kable(
  tbl1,
  format   = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  escape   = FALSE,           # allow \hspace{} and \% to pass through
  align    = "lllr",
  col.names = c(
    "Characteristic",
    paste0("CHU (n = ", n_chu, ")"),
    paste0("CHEU (n = ", n_cheu, ")"),
    "\\textit{p}-value"
  ),
  caption = paste0(
    "Baseline infant and maternal characteristics by HIV exposure group. ",
    "Significance: *$p<0.05$, **$p<0.01$, ***$p<0.001$."
  ),
  label = "tab:baseline"
) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"),
    font_size     = 10
  ) |>
  row_spec(0,         bold = TRUE) |>          # column headers
  row_spec(bold_rows, bold = TRUE) |>          # category-header rows
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "$p$-values: two-sample $t$-test for gestational age; ",
      "chi-squared test for all categorical variables."
    ),
    general_title     = "\\textbf{Note:}",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
    escape            = FALSE
  )

# ── write to file ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
writeLines(latex_tbl, "table1_baseline.tex")
message("LaTeX table written to table1_baseline.tex")

g

Table 2 – Summary of Growth Outcomes by HIV Group and Visit

Mean (SD) of zwfl at each study visit by HIV exposure group. Between-group differences tested with two-sample t-tests at each visit. Significance codes: *p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001.

# Compute means and SDs per group per visit
growth_tbl <- analysis_dat |>
  filter(!is.na(zwfl), !is.na(hiv_group)) |>
  group_by(visit, hiv_group) |>
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    m_zwfl   = mean(zwfl, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_zwfl  = sd(zwfl,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    zwfl_fmt = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", m_zwfl, sd_zwfl)
  )

# t-test p-values per visit
pvals_visit <- analysis_dat |>
  filter(!is.na(zwfl), !is.na(hiv_group)) |>
  group_by(visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_zwfl = tryCatch(t.test(zwfl ~ hiv_group)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    p_zwfl_fmt = fmt_p(p_zwfl)
  )

# Pivot wide: one row per visit
growth_wide <- growth_tbl |>
  select(visit, hiv_group, n, zwfl_fmt) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = hiv_group,
    values_from = c(n, zwfl_fmt)
  ) |>
  left_join(pvals_visit |> select(visit, p_zwfl_fmt),
            by = "visit") |>
  select(
    visit,
    n_CHU,  zwfl_fmt_CHU,
    n_CHEU, zwfl_fmt_CHEU,
    p_zwfl_fmt
  )

kable(
  growth_wide,
  col.names = c(
    "Visit",
    "N", "zwfl Mean (SD)",
    "N", "zwfl Mean (SD)",
    "p-value"
  ),
  caption  = paste0(
    "Table 2. Mean (SD) of weight-for-length Z-score (zwfl) by HIV exposure group and study visit. ",
    "Significance: *p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001."
  ),
  booktabs = TRUE,
  align    = "lrlrlc"
) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"),
    font_size     = 9
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c(
    " "                = 1,
    "CHU"              = 2,
    "CHEU"             = 2,
    "Group difference" = 1
  )) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "zwfl = weight-for-length Z-score. ",
      "p-values from two-sample t-test at each visit (unadjusted for multiple comparisons)."
    ),
    general_title     = "Note:",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )

Exploratory Plots

Figure 1 – Individual Growth Trajectories and Mean Profiles (zwfl)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# ── shared theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_report <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

hiv_colors <- c("CHU" = "#2166AC", "CHEU" = "#D6604D")

# ── Panel A: spaghetti + LOESS ────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig1a <- analysis_dat |>
  filter(!is.na(zwfl), !is.na(hiv_group)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = infage_month, y = zwfl,
             group = newid, color = hiv_group)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = hiv_group),
              method = "loess", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2, span = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hiv_colors,
                     labels = c("CHU"  = "HIV-unexposed (CHU)",
                                "CHEU" = "HIV-exposed uninfected (CHEU)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1.5, 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24),
    labels = c("1.5", "3", "6", "9", "12", "18", "24")
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Infant age (months)",
    y     = "Weight-for-length Z-score",
    color = "HIV exposure group",
    tag   = "A"
  ) +
  theme_report() 

# ── Panel B: mean ± 95% CI at each visit ──────────────────────────────────────
visit_levels <- c("delivery", "week-3", "week-6",
                  "month-3",  "month-6", "month-9",
                  "month-12", "month-18", "month-24")

fig1b <- analysis_dat |>
  filter(!is.na(zwfl), !is.na(hiv_group)) |>
  mutate(visit = factor(visit, levels = visit_levels)) |>
  group_by(visit, hiv_group) |>
  summarise(
    mean_zwfl = mean(zwfl, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_zwfl   = sd(zwfl, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(zwfl))),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = visit, y = mean_zwfl,
             group = hiv_group, color = hiv_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_zwfl - 1.96 * se_zwfl,
                    ymax = mean_zwfl + 1.96 * se_zwfl),
                width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hiv_colors,
                     labels = c("CHU"  = "HIV-unexposed (CHU)",
                                "CHEU" = "HIV-exposed uninfected (CHEU)")) +
  labs(
    x     = "Study visit",
    y     = "Mean weight-for-length Z-score",
    color = "HIV exposure group",
    tag   = "B"
  ) +
  theme_report() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

# ── Combine side by side with single shared legend ────────────────────────────
fig1_combined <- (fig1a | fig1b) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("fig1_combined.pdf", plot = fig1_combined,
       width = 13, height = 5.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

Figure 2 – Growth Trajectories Stratified by Breastfeeding Status

Mean zwfl +/- 95% CI at each visit, jointly stratified by HIV group and breastfeeding status at 1 year. Motivates the interaction structure in the statistical model.

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ── shared theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_report <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),       # ← wider key for dashed line
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      legend.box       = "vertical",            # ← stack the two legends
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

hiv_colors <- c("CHU" = "#2166AC", "CHEU" = "#D6604D")

visit_levels <- c("delivery", "week-3", "week-6",
                  "month-3",  "month-6", "month-9",
                  "month-12", "month-18", "month-24")

# ── Figure 2 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig2 <- analysis_dat |>
  filter(!is.na(zwfl), !is.na(hiv_group), !is.na(bf_current_1year)) |>
  mutate(visit = factor(visit, levels = visit_levels)) |>
  group_by(visit, hiv_group, bf_current_1year) |>
  summarise(
    mean_zwfl = mean(zwfl, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_zwfl   = sd(zwfl,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(zwfl))),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x        = visit,
    y        = mean_zwfl,
    group    = interaction(hiv_group, bf_current_1year),
    colour   = hiv_group,
    linetype = bf_current_1year
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_zwfl - 1.96 * se_zwfl,
        ymax = mean_zwfl + 1.96 * se_zwfl),
    width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = hiv_colors,
    labels = c("CHU"  = "HIV-unexposed (CHU)",
               "CHEU" = "HIV-exposed uninfected (CHEU)")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("No" = "dashed", "Yes" = "solid"),
    labels = c("No"  = "Not breastfed at 1 year",
               "Yes" = "Breastfed at 1 year")
  ) +
  guides(
    colour   = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 1, title = "HIV exposure group"),
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 1, title = "Breastfeeding status at 1 year")
  ) +
  labs(
    x        = "Study visit",

vis_miss(analysis_dat)

Analytic Dataset

# Complete cases for all primary model variables.
# Excludes: 37 missing zwfl, 22 missing bf_current_1year, 5 missing ebf_updated.
main_dat <- analysis_dat |>
  filter(
    !is.na(zwfl),
    !is.na(hiv_group),
    !is.na(infage_month),
    !is.na(bf_current_1year),
    !is.na(ebf_updated),
    !is.na(sex)
  )

Statistical Model

Model Specification

We fit a linear mixed effects model (LME) to account for the correlation of repeated measures within each infant. The general model is:

\[Y_{ij} = \beta_0 + \beta_1 H_i + \beta_2 B_i + \beta_3 t^*_{ij} + \beta_4 S_i + \text{interactions} + u_i + \varepsilon_{ij}\]

where:

  • \(Y_{ij}\) = zwfl for infant \(i\) at time \(j\)
  • \(H_i\) = HIV group (0 = CHU, 1 = CHEU)
  • \(B_i\) = breastfeeding status (0 = No, 1 = Yes)
  • \(t^*_{ij}\) = mean-centred age in months: \(t^* = t - \bar{t}\)
  • \(S_i\) = infant sex (0 = Female, 1 = Male)
  • \(u_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2_u)\) = random intercept per infant
  • \(\varepsilon_{ij} \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)\) =s residual error

Mean-centring age improves optimizer convergence and makes \(\beta_0\) interpretable as expected zwfl at the mean observed age rather than at birth.

Stage 1 – Random Effects Structure Selection (REML = TRUE)

We use AIC with REML = TRUE (required for comparing random effects structures) to choose between:

\[\text{Random intercept only: } \quad u_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\, \sigma^2_u)\]

\[\text{Random intercept + slope: } \quad \begin{pmatrix} u_i \\ v_i \end{pmatrix} \sim \mathcal{N}\!\left(\mathbf{0},\, \boldsymbol{\Sigma}\right), \quad \boldsymbol{\Sigma} = \begin{pmatrix} \sigma^2_u & \rho\sigma_u\sigma_v \\ \rho\sigma_u\sigma_v & \sigma^2_v \end{pmatrix}\]

# first check if we need to add random slope
model1_zwfl <- lmer(
  zwfl ~ hiv_group * infage_month +
         bf_current_1year * infage_month + 
         hiv_group * bf_current_1year + 
         sex + (1 | newid),
  data = main_dat,
  REML = TRUE   # REML = TRUE required for random effects comparison
)

model1_zwfl_slope <- lmer(
  zwfl ~ hiv_group * infage_month +
         bf_current_1year * infage_month + 
         hiv_group * bf_current_1year + 
         sex + (1 + infage_month | newid),
  data = main_dat,
  REML = TRUE   # REML = TRUE required for random effects comparison
)

Final Model Parameter Estimates

# Refit chosen (final) model with REML = TRUE for unbiased parameter estimates
# Update model formula below based on model comparison result above

tidy(model1_zwfl,
     effects  = "fixed",
     conf.int = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    term = dplyr::recode(term,
      "(Intercept)"                          = "Intercept",
      "hiv_groupCHEU"                        = "HIV group: CHEU vs CHU",
      "infage_month"                         = "Age (months)",
      "bf_current_1yearYes"                  = "Breastfeeding: Yes vs No",
      "sexmale"                              = "Sex: Male vs Female",
      "hiv_groupCHEU:infage_month"           = "CHEU x Age",
      "infage_month:bf_current_1yearYes"     = "Breastfeeding x Age",
      "hiv_groupCHEU:bf_current_1yearYes"    = "CHEU x Breastfeeding"
    ),
    across(c(estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high), ~round(.x, 3)),
    sig     = pstar(p.value),
    p.value = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ paste0("<0.001", sig),
      TRUE            ~ paste0(sprintf("%.3f", p.value), sig)
    )
  ) |>
  select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Term", "Estimate", "SE",
                  "95% CI Lower", "95% CI Upper", "p-value"),
    caption   = paste0(
      "Table 3. Fixed effects estimates from final linear mixed effects model. ",
      "Primary outcome: weight-for-length Z-score (zwfl). ",
      "Significance: *p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001."
    ),
    booktabs  = TRUE,
    align     = "lrrrrr"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = "hold_position",
    font_size     = 12
  ) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "Estimates are change in zwfl per unit increase in the predictor. ",
      "Reference group: CHU, not breastfed, female, at mean age. ",
      "Model fitted with REML = TRUE."
    ),
    general_title     = "Note:",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )
